def transform(grid):
    objs = {}
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v:
                objs.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    # Each color is a 3x3 motif; output side-by-side in original reading order,
    # maintaining zero padding between motifs.
    motifs=[]
    for color,cells in objs.items():
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        motifs.append([[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c]==color else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)])
    motifs.sort(key=lambda m: next((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]))
    # order by position of object top-left
    colors=sorted(objs, key=lambda v:(min(r for r,c in objs[v]), min(c for r,c in objs[v])))
    motifs=[]
    for v in colors:
        cells=objs[v]; r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        motifs.append([[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)])
    return [sum(([motifs[j][i] for j in range(len(motifs))]),[]) for i in range(3)]
PY
